<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844" width="390" height="844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#1C1E21"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#1C1E21"/>

  <!-- Status Bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="22" y="24" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#E4E6EB">9:41</text>
    <circle cx="331" cy="16" r="2" fill="#E4E6EB"/>
    <circle cx="338" cy="16" r="2" fill="#E4E6EB"/>
    <circle cx="345" cy="16" r="2" fill="#E4E6EB"/>
    <rect x="320" y="10" width="10" height="12" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-opacity="0.35" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="321.5" y="11.5" width="7" height="9" rx="1.2" fill="#E4E6EB"/>
    <circle cx="356" cy="16" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <line x1="353.5" y1="16" x2="358.5" y2="16" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <line x1="356" y1="13.5" x2="356" y2="18.5" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <rect x="368" y="10.5" width="18" height="10" rx="2.3" fill="none" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <rect x="386" y="13.8" width="2.2" height="3.4" rx="0.6" fill="#E4E6EB"/>
    <rect x="370" y="12.3" width="13" height="6.4" rx="1.2" fill="#E4E6EB"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="76" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="48" font-weight="700" fill="#1877F2">Hello!</text>
    <text x="24" y="110" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="400" fill="#B0B3B8">Signup to get Started</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Username field -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="155" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#B0B3B8">Username</text>
    <rect x="24" y="162" width="342" height="48" rx="6" fill="#3A3B3C" stroke="#3A3B3C"/>
    <text x="38" y="192" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">sarah.chen</text>
    <circle cx="346" cy="186" r="11" fill="#50545B"/>
    <circle cx="346" cy="181.5" r="3.6" fill="#E4E6EB"/>
    <rect x="340" y="186.5" width="12" height="7" rx="3.5" fill="#E4E6EB"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Password field -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="244" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#B0B3B8">Password</text>
    <rect x="24" y="251" width="342" height="48" rx="6" fill="#3A3B3C" stroke="#3A3B3C"/>
    <text x="38" y="281" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">••••••••••••</text>
    <circle cx="346" cy="275" r="11" fill="#50545B"/>
    <circle cx="346" cy="275" r="5.8" fill="none" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <line x1="341.2" y1="270.2" x2="350.8" y2="279.8" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Remember me + forgot -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="317" width="20" height="20" rx="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polyline points="28,327 32,331 39,322" fill="none" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="52" y="332" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#B0B3B8">Remember me</text>
    <text x="257" y="332" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#5890FF">Forgot password?</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Primary button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="360" width="342" height="50" rx="6" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <text x="195" y="392" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Login</text>
  </g>

  <g>
    <text x="195" y="447" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#B0B3B8">or continue with</text>
    <line x1="24" y1="441" x2="147" y2="441" stroke="#3A3B3C" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="243" y1="441" x2="366" y2="441" stroke="#3A3B3C" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Social buttons -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="462" width="162" height="48" rx="6" fill="#EEF1F4"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="486" r="11" fill="#18ACFE"/>
    <path d="" />
    <text x="74" y="492" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#667080">Facebook</text>

    <rect x="204" y="462" width="162" height="48" rx="6" fill="#EEF1F4"/>
    <circle cx="228" cy="486" r="11" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="228" cy="486" r="11" fill="none" stroke="#E0E3E8" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="223" y="481" width="10" height="10" rx="2" fill="#4285F4"/>
    <rect x="223" y="481" width="5.2" height="10" rx="2" fill="#34A853"/>
    <text x="254" y="492" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#667080">Google</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Feature card area -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="528" width="342" height="136" rx="10" fill="#3A3B3C"/>
    <rect x="26" y="530" width="342" height="136" rx="10" fill="#000000" fill-opacity="0.10"/>
    <rect x="36" y="544" width="84" height="84" rx="8" fill="#50545B"/>
    <circle cx="58" cy="566" r="6" fill="#FFD789"/>
    <polygon points="38,618 56,596 70,611 80,598 112,618" fill="#667080"/>
    <text x="136" y="560" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#E4E6EB">Your account, your news</text>
    <text x="136" y="586" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#B0B3B8">Save reading preferences, follow</text>
    <text x="136" y="608" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#B0B3B8">topics, and keep your session synced.</text>
    <rect x="136" y="620" width="118" height="28" rx="6" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <text x="195" y="639" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Learn more</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Divider / footer prompt -->
  <line x1="24" y1="692" x2="366" y2="692" stroke="#3A3B3C" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <text x="88" y="734" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#B0B3B8">Already have an account?</text>
    <text x="273" y="734" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#1877F2">Sign in</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom Navigation Bar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="766" width="390" height="78" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="766" x2="390" y2="766" stroke="#000000" stroke-opacity="0.08" stroke-width="1"/>

    <!-- Home -->
    <g transform="translate(30,781)">
      <polygon points="12,0 0,9 24,9" fill="#1877F2"/>
      <rect x="5" y="9" width="14" height="12" rx="2" fill="#1877F2"/>
      <text x="12" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#1877F2">Home</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Explore -->
    <g transform="translate(108,781)">
      <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <polygon points="12,6 14,12 18,14 12,18 8,12 10,10" fill="#667080"/>
      <text x="12" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#667080">Explore</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Bookmark -->
    <g transform="translate(186,781)">
      <rect x="6" y="3" width="12" height="18" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <polygon points="6,21 12,16 18,21" fill="#667080"/>
      <text x="12" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#667080">Saved</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Profile -->
    <g transform="translate(264,781)">
      <circle cx="12" cy="9" r="5" fill="#667080"/>
      <rect x="5" y="15" width="14" height="8" rx="4" fill="#667080"/>
      <text x="12" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#667080">Profile</text>
    </g>

    <!-- More -->
    <g transform="translate(342,781)">
      <circle cx="4" cy="12" r="1.8" fill="#667080"/>
      <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="1.8" fill="#667080"/>
      <circle cx="20" cy="12" r="1.8" fill="#667080"/>
      <text x="12" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#667080">More</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Extra decorative app content to fill screen -->
  <g opacity="0.95">
    <rect x="24" y="106" width="342" height="1" fill="#3A3B3C"/>
    <rect x="24" y="214" width="342" height="1" fill="#3A3B3C"/>
    <rect x="24" y="300" width="342" height="1" fill="#3A3B3C"/>
    <rect x="24" y="414" width="342" height="1" fill="#3A3B3C"/>
    <rect x="24" y="506" width="342" height="1" fill="#3A3B3C"/>
  </g>
</svg>
